value.body: Academic content developers write and review the learning material children use: textbook chapters, worksheets, activities, video scripts and test questions. Educational publishers, edtech companies and education NGOs hire them. Most of the day is writing and editing to curriculum guidelines and style rules.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: D.El.Ed or B.Ed, often with a graduate degree

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Word processors, content management systems, curriculum documents

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Hiring usually involves a writing test on a topic for a given grade. Classroom experience with primary children and a good command of English or a regional language help applicants stand out.

value.title: At a glance
items: Contract and freelance work is common in this field.
Next steps: senior content developer, editor, or instructional designer.
Primary-grade content is a distinct niche from higher-grade subjects.

value.title: School enrolment by level
value.note: Share of school enrolment by level of education; a sense of where learning material is used, not of jobs. Percentages are rounded.
